title: Constrained boundary sweep with locked central cavity (8 fixed + 8 variable)
scientific_hypothesis: The central 8 layers (indices 4–11) from iteration_15 form a stable cavity resonance that should be preserved; performance gains remain in the outer boundary pairs where impedance matching to air and Ge substrate can be re-optimized without disturbing core modes.
design_principle: Fix layers 4–11 at iteration_15 best candidate thicknesses [411.0, 966.0, 878.0, 1273.0, 500.0, 465.0, 454.0, 403.0] nm; allow layers 0–3 and 12–15 to vary within ±40 nm of their round-4 values [1130.0, 874.0, 481.0, 227.0] and [275.0, 938.0, 733.0, 1257.0] nm respectively, using gradient-based thickness optimization.
design_variables: thicknesses_nm for layers 0-3 and 12-15 (8 variables total); layers 4-11 fixed
soft_objectives: Maximize mean transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band
Minimize mean transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band
Maintain or improve best_target_score relative to 0.3391 baseline
manufacturing_considerations: ±40 nm perturbation bounds represent realistic deposition tolerance for boundary layers
Central layers locked to reduce optimization complexity and preserve verified resonance
theory_basis: Interference-based dichroic filter design with quarter-wave stack principles
Boundary layer impedance matching dominates incidence-side and substrate-side reflection losses
expected_advantages: Preserves verified cavity resonance from prior rounds
Focused optimization reduces search space and avoids destabilizing core modes
May reveal whether boundary layers or core layers limit further improvement
known_risks: If boundary layers are not the limiting factor, score may stagnate near 0.3391
±40 nm bounds may be too restrictive if larger adjustments are needed for impedance matching
execution_request_english: Optimize a 16-layer ZnSe/ZnS alternating stack on Ge substrate with air incidence. Initialize layers 0-3 at [1130.0, 874.0, 481.0, 227.0] nm and layers 12-15 at [275.0, 938.0, 733.0, 1257.0] nm; fix layers 4-11 at [411.0, 966.0, 878.0, 1273.0, 500.0, 465.0, 454.0, 403.0] nm. Allow optimization of layers 0-3 and 12-15 only, with thickness bounds of ±40 nm from initialization values. Use gradient_thickness optimizer. Evaluate mean transmittance in 8000-11000 nm (maximize) and 3000-5000 nm (minimize) at normal incidence, unpolarized. Registry-resolve ZnS, ZnSe, Ge optical constants. Canonical user controls: wavelength intervals 8000-11000 nm, 3000-5000 nm. soft objectives: High transmittance in 8000-11000 nm band; Low transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. behaviors to suppress or avoid: High transmittance in 3000-5000 nm band. manufacturing constraints: Total layer count not exceeding 16.
revision_reason: Directly implements feedback directive from iteration_15 insight_appendage: lock central 8 layers to preserve cavity resonance, perturb outer boundary pairs ±40 nm to re-exploit impedance mismatches without disturbing stable core modes.
